tools.name: ping
tools.description:
Connectivity check that confirms the Nordic MCP server process is responding.

Use this at the start of a session to verify the server is reachable before
making other calls. Do not use as a proxy for database health — the server can
respond while the Qdrant vector database is temporarily unavailabl

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description:
Look up a company in the official business registry for Norway, Denmark or Finland.

Use this to retrieve authoritative registration data (legal name, status, address)
for a known organisation number. Do not use for Sweden (SE) — use search_filings
with country='SE' instead, as Bolagsverket integrat

tools.name: search_filings
tools.description:
Search the Nordic financial database for company filings, press releases
and macroeconomic summaries.

Use this as the primary tool for any question about Nordic listed companies,
markets or macro conditions. Do not use to retrieve a full document — results
are chunked text excerpts; use parse_pdf_t

tools.name: parse_pdf_to_text
tools.description:
Download a PDF from a URL and extract all text content, page by page.

Use this to read the full text of a specific document — for example, an annual
report PDF linked from a search_filings result. Best combined with search_filings:
use search_filings to locate the document, then parse_pdf_to_text f

tools.name: get_current_power_price
tools.description:
Fetch today's hourly day-ahead electricity spot prices for a Nordic bidding zone.

Use this for current and near-term (today/tomorrow) price queries. Do not use
for historical price analysis — use search_filings with report_type='macro_summary'
and a date reference in the query for that purpose.
Tom

tools.name: company_research
tools.description:
Run multiple targeted searches and return raw results grouped by section.

The caller defines all sections and queries — this tool does not decide what is
relevant. Before calling, reason about which topics and data sources matter for
this specific company: financial metrics, risk factors, sector-sp

tools.name: analyze_company
tools.description:
AI-powered company analysis using semantic search over Nordic financial data.

Orchestrates multiple searches internally and returns a synthesized narrative
answer with source citations. Covers annual reports, quarterly reports, press
releases and macroeconomic context for Nordic listed companies.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "company_research" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Run multiple targeted searches and return raw results grouped by section. The caller defines all sections and queries — this tool does not decide what is releva…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
